import tslearn.metrics

# Compute LCSS similarity between identical time series
sim_identical = tslearn.metrics.lcss(s1, s1, eps=0.5)

# Compute LCSS similarity between two different time series with a global constraint
sim_diff = tslearn.metrics.lcss(s1, s2, eps=0.5, global_constraint="sakoe_chiba", sakoe_chiba_radius=3)

# LCSS returns a similarity score between 0.0 and 1.0
assert isinstance(sim_identical, float), "Expected LCSS to return a float"
assert sim_identical == 1.0, f"Expected identical series to have LCSS similarity 1.0, got {sim_identical}"
assert 0.0 <= sim_diff <= 1.0, f"Expected similarity between 0.0 and 1.0, got {sim_diff}"

print(f"__CHECK__ lcss {sim_identical}, {sim_diff:.4f}")
